title: Active sessions over time
description: Sessions with at least one event in each period, by agent type.
viz_content: SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, agent_type, uniq(session_id) AS sessions FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') GROUP BY time, agent_type ORDER BY time

title: Activity mix
description: Prompts, model requests, tool calls and replies over time. Claude Code sends no row per model request on the hook path.
viz_content: SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, multi_if(event_type = 'user_input', 'prompt', event_type = 'llm_request', 'model request', event_type = 'tool_invoke', 'tool call', event_type = 'llm_response' AND assistant_message != '', 'reply', '') AS activity, count() AS events FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND multi_if(event_type = 'user_input', 'prompt', event_type = 'llm_request', 'model request', event_type = 'tool_invoke', 'tool call', event_type = 'llm_response' AND assistant_message != '', 'reply', '') != '' GROUP BY time, activity ORDER BY time

title: Sessions by project
description: Sessions per working directory (last path segment), by agent type.
viz_content: SELECT project, agent, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, array_element(split_by_char('/', any_if(json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd'), json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd') != '')), -1) AS project FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') GROUP BY session_id) WHERE project != '' GROUP BY project, agent ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

title: Session profile by agent type
description: Length and size of the sessions seen in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT agent, count() AS sessions, round(median(minutes), 1) AS median_minutes, round(max(minutes), 1) AS longest_minutes, round(avg(prompts), 1) AS avg_prompts, round(avg(tool_calls), 1) AS avg_tool_calls FROM (SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, date_diff('second', min(event_time), max(event_time)) / 60 AS minutes, count_if(event_type = 'user_input') AS prompts, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') GROUP BY session_id) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY sessions DESC

title: Waiting on a person
description: Permission requests, denials and notifications (idle, permission prompt) over time.
viz_content: SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, multi_if(event_type = 'permission_request', 'permission request', event_type = 'permission_denied', 'permission denied', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.notification_type') != '', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.notification_type'), 'notification') AS kind, count() AS events FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type IN ('permission_request', 'permission_denied', 'notification') GROUP BY time, kind ORDER BY time

title: Sessions
description: The 100 most recently active sessions, the latest at the bottom. 'active' means an event in the last 5 minutes.
viz_content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, any_if(model, model != '') AS model, array_element(split_by_char('/', any_if(json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd'), json_value(raw_event_data, '$.cwd') != '')), -1) AS project, min(event_time) AS started, max(event_time) AS last_event, round(date_diff('second', min(event_time), max(event_time)) / 60, 1) AS minutes, count_if(event_type = 'user_input') AS prompts, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, multi_if(max(event_time) > now() - 5m, 'active', count_if(event_type = 'session_end') > 0, 'ended', 'idle') AS state FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_event DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY last_event
